name: alhambra
documented_evidence: Patronato publishes Myrtles court36×23m and pool34×7.1m, Comares external height45m and124 marble columns. Granada municipal image archive gives Lions Court28.5×15.7m. Raw OSM historic boundary92528618 supplies the201-point circuit, with separate named towers, Nasrid Palace, Charles V and church footprints.
modeling_qualifications: Charles V63m square and30m open court are dimensional anchors. Comares45m includes downhill wall: modeled foot−17m and courtyard-relative top28m. Lions Court has116 perimeter columns and8 pavilion columns,124 total; historical grouping remains simplified. Alcazaba and Partal use lower sampled terraces; the irregular long rampart follows production ground. Secondary tower heights and much carved decoration are estimates. Hotel/service infill outside authored structures remains native.
